name: reserved-v2, json/verify
scope: Reserved set v2 (R2), first and only run of Phase 2: one retained-source HTTP replay per case through the engine, API and SDK of each named commit, same request for both. Measures extraction and delivery on saved bytes, not live access, routing or freshness (that run belongs to K1). Each case adds a json format with a schema and a verify contract derived from its task (json_plans.py); the Markdown, tables and links request is otherwise unchanged.
verify: Per case: json.status equals complete, every required field present, and the task's records present by index. A success result is status success with verification not failed.
modelFallback: modelFallback is false on both sides: no extraction model (W2L_EXTRACT_BASE_URL, W2L_EXTRACT_MODEL) is configured where the pair runs, so the deterministic path is measured and F2 (model values kept only where the page states them) is not.
